title: Issuing PRNs and PERNs as a reprocessor or exporter - GOV.UK

triage.reason: GOV.UK published updated official guidance (1 Oct 2026) for accredited reprocessors and exporters on issuing PRNs/PERNs under UK packaging EPR, including the new 2026-27 allowance to issue on 'reasonably associated' material, which sets out operative rules for producers' recycling obligations.
